a.title: Binance says hackers used fake job interviews and an internal AI tool to pull off the $6.3 billion heist

b.lede: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance says North Korean hackers used a fake job interview to trick an employee into installing malware that ultimately let them compromise the company's wallet infrastructure and steal about $6.34 billion in digital assets. [...]
